title: service-automation: a parent-id resume of a `map` whose parked item run was cancelled still advances past that item
body:
domain:server#4 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4d1Np3hU7RQnA13YZcL

Ruled: 6523833308 · letter A · 2026-10-30T13:22Z
Ruling-ref: 6523833308

Filing gate: ① read beside a ruled card by the #27877 dev (PR #27951, os-dev-report 6515519800, out-of-scope finding) and escalated for filing by its contract review 6515887943. Filed by `domain:server` seat 4. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets the lane and grade, and whether it is the accepted shape.

## What the code does (read, not measured)

After PR #27951 a parent-id resume of a `map` whose item child is still suspended is refused `409 RESUME_CHILD_PENDING`. The ruling (triage 6513867475) covers a still-suspended item only. When the item run is gone because it was cancelled through `cancelRun`, which does not touch the parent, a parent-id resume of the `map` still advances past that item: the map moves on as if the item had run.

## Wanted (route is triage's)

Decide whether advancing past a cancelled item is the accepted shape (cancellation means skip), or whether the parent should record the item as cancelled or fail. Measure first through `engine.resume`.

## Also from the same review (docs, no behaviour)

The new 409 is missing from the code lists in `packages/client/src/index.ts` (~L5947) and `packages/services/service-automation/README.md` (~L310), and `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/automation.json` has no `409 RESUME_CHILD_PENDING` row. These can ride whichever PR takes this card.

## Dedupe

Read the open titles for `map` + `cancel`, `parked item`, `RESUME_CHILD_PENDING`: only #27877. **New.**
